DP01.text: Customer and operational data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 using Cloud KMS-managed keys, and in transit with TLS 1.3. Our key-management policy is attached as key-management-policy.md; keys rotate every 90 days and rotation is logged.

DP02.text: Operational records are retained for 24 months and report exports for 12 months. Deletion runs nightly against both primary storage and backups; backups reach full expiry 35 days after the primary deletion, which is stated in our retention schedule.

AC01.text: Multi-factor authentication is required for all staff on all systems, including administrative access to production. There are no exemptions. Two break-glass accounts exist; both require hardware tokens held by two named directors and every use raises an alert.

AC02.text: Privileged access is granted through a request-and-approval workflow with a named approver, is time-bound to 8 hours, and is reviewed quarterly. The most recent quarterly review is summarised in section 4 of our SOC 2 report.

IR01.text: Our contractual notification window is 72 hours from confirmed detection. The incident response plan names the on-call security lead as the decision maker and the Head of Information Security as the notifier.

IR02.text: We have had no security incidents affecting customer data in the last 24 months. One availability incident occurred on 4 February 2025 lasting 41 minutes, with no data exposure; it is recorded in section 6 of our SOC 2 report.

CP01.text: Our SOC 2 Type II report for the period 1 January to 31 December 2025 is attached. The auditor is Harlow & Finch LLP and the opinion is unqualified.

CP02.text: The report covers CleanCloud Reporting and the underlying data platform, including the standard tier being purchased. Our internal staging environment is out of scope and holds no customer data.

CP03.text: The report records no exceptions. Two observations were raised and both were remediated inside the reporting period; they are listed in section 5.

CP04.text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, certificate number ISO-27001-CC-4471, issued by Meridian Certification Services, valid to 30 September 2027. The certificate is attached.

SP01.text: Our subprocessor list is attached. We use three subprocessors: a cloud infrastructure provider, a transactional email provider and a support ticketing provider. None of them process customer content; the email and ticketing providers process contact names and email addresses only.

BC01.text: RTO is 4 hours and RPO is 15 minutes for the reporting service. Our most recent disaster recovery test was on 11 November 2025 and met both objectives; results are in section 7 of the SOC 2 report.
